title: Effect of liquid surface area on hydrogen sulfide oxidation during micro-aeration in dairy manure digesters

abstract_evidence_excerpt: The objectives of this study were to evaluate headspace aeration for reducing H2S levels in low cost plug flow digesters and to characterize the relationship between the liquid surface area and H2S oxidation rates. Methane production was not affected by aeration rates that resulted in headspace oxygen levels of up to 1%.
